prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” roofing company for every Dallas roof replacement — the right contractor depends on your budget, the roofing material you want, your property’s specifics, and the contractor’s experience with local codes and storms. I can help you pick the best one for your situation. Here’s a practical way to find and vet top choices quickly.

How to find the best Dallas roof replacement contractor
- Look for manufacturer certifications (GAF Master Elite, Owens Corning Platinum Preferred, CertainTeed SELECT ShingleMaster). These mean the roofer meets training and insurance requirements and can offer enhanced manufacturer warranties.  
- Check reviews and complaints: Google, Yelp, Angi, and the BBB (look for A+ and few/no unresolved complaints). Focus on recent reviews for work similar to yours.  
- Verify licensing and insurance: confirm TX roofing license if required locally, ask for proof of general liability and workers’ comp, and call the insurer to verify the policy is current.  
- Ask for references: get at least 3 recent local customers and visit if possible.  
- Get at least 3 written estimates: compare scope (tear-off vs overlay), materials, underlayment type, ventilation, flashing, and clean-up.  
- Confirm warranties: manufacturer warranty on shingles and a workmanship warranty from the contractor (written, length specified).  
- Check for storm-chaser signs: prefer established local companies (years in business, local address/office).  
- Red flags: demand for full payment up front, high-pressure sales tactics, vague or no written contract, no permit pull/handling of inspections.

Questions to ask a contractor
- Are you licensed and insured? Can you provide certificates?  
- Do you have [manufacturer] certifications? (GAF, Owens Corning, CertainTeed)  
- Will you handle permits and inspections?  
- What’s included in your price (tear-off, disposal, underlayment, ice/water shield, new flashing, ventilation)?  
- What warranties do you provide (length and what’s covered)?  
- Can I see recent local reference addresses and photos of finished jobs?

If you want, I can:
- Help compare 2–3 written estimates you receive (line-by-line).  
- Provide a short list of Dallas-area contractors to consider if you tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood — I’ll explain how to vet each.  
- Provide a sample checklist/contract template for the work.

Which would you prefer — a tailored shortlist for your neighborhood, or help comparing estimates you’ve already got?
